name: Level CCRP 18k (LGB)
summary: Straight and level, WSO lases from the pod, CCRP release
procedure: A/G master mode, CCRP; TGP designated on the target, laser code set
Wings level, pickle and hold — release at the cue
WSO lases from 8–10 s before impact until impact

name: Level CCRP 22k (JDAM)
summary: Straight and level inside the LAR, CCRP release
procedure: A/G master mode, CCRP; JDAM target coordinates loaded
Inside the LAR: wings level, pickle and hold until release

name: 30° Dive CCIP
summary: Roll in from 8,000 ft, 30° dive, pickle at 4,500 ft
procedure: Roll in, pipper short of the target and let it walk up
Pickle at release altitude — 4 G recovery

name: 45° Dive CCIP
summary: Steep dive from 12,000 ft, pickle at 6,500 ft
procedure: Steep roll-in — the Eagle builds speed fast, throttle back
Pickle at release altitude — 5 G recovery, do not press

name: Pop-up 4 nm
summary: Low run-in, pop at 4 nm to a 7,500 ft apex, 20° dive
procedure: A/G master mode, CCIP set before the IP
At the pop: pull, MAX power, check the apex altitude
Roll in, pipper on, pickle at release altitude

name: Laydown 500 ft (HD)
summary: Fast and low, CCRP release of high-drag bombs
procedure: A/G master mode, CCRP, target designated
Level at 500 ft, pickle and hold through release
